pkgmetadata.longdescription: Just a Sample is a modern, open-source audio sampler plugin built with JUCE. It features an integrated Bungee time-stretcher for independent time and pitch modulation, an optimised waveform display, a routable FX chain (reverb, chorus, distortion, EQ), a waveform/wavetable mode, direct sample recording and experimental auto-tuning. Built here as a VST3 plugin.
